status: freeze before new fit, scores or performance selection
primary: First final delisting 12 calendar months, within-year AUC weighted by event × control pairs. Exposed 2023–2025. All fixed seed 42/101/202, 32 trees each; equal company-level CIF before metrics.
design: F=41 financial G1-G5 + 4 common controls; A=7 prior audit; M=21 numerical market + coverage Q. M0=F, M1=F+A, M2=F+M, M3=F+A+M. No imputation, altered labels, seed choice or new calibration. Use matched original M3 only after source verification.
time_gate: Use frozen conservative financial source convention (actual public report and latest recorded corrections; all used components before origin, do not certify every original PDF). Recompute all finite financial, market and common control values, dates and IDs. For A require actual public evidence for prior audit opinion and going-concern status by origin, including report-year/version/actual date or unambiguous entry notice. Vendor ST announcement date alone does not establish the retrospectively attached audit fields. If not established for the complete matched cohort, stop audit-containing comparisons and interactions. No deleting or relabeling rows. Preserve historical M3 only as explicitly non-qualifying descriptive evidence.
models: q2 depth4, min_leaf10/min_groups5/min_events3, shared_quantile5, mtry75, balanced per-tree25; signed_sum (1,1); child terminations 0 or >=2 unique companies; direct raw-parent AJ10. Company bootstrap same yearly sample/seed; no requirement of same splits. No tuning.
sensitivity: Proportional pool round-half-up of 25*p/74 for M0/M1/M2; M3 identical to fixed25. Supplement fixed25 F+numeric market alone and F+A+numeric market, plus F+Q versus F. All sensitivities secondary. Physical training only once for a distinct permitted configuration.
endpoint: 12/24 calendar months both causes, 2025H24 metrics NA. Existing censoring/competing-event evaluator; all supported complete endpoints have unit IPCW, unknown never controls. Top20 ceiling by annual cohort with historical tie rule. Pooled metrics recomputed over companies. Annual quartile calibration by risk, no fitting.
contrasts: A=M1-M0, M=M2-M0, A|M=M3-M2, M|A=M3-M1, INT=M3-M1-M2+M0. Loss contrasts use negative Brier as utility; raw Brier in model results. Blocked contrasts NA. All fixed members and ensemble; 1000 paired within-year company draws seed 2026110201, same saved indices. Conditional percentile intervals, invalid counts; no statistical independence or causality claims.
mechanism: Blind to forecasts when classifying. Reuse officially sourced reviewed old terminal grounds, join actual old sample ID and event; separately inspect extant terminal decision notices for additional cases where unambiguous. Keep unknowns, no subgroup AUC. Compare incremental capture and mean event risk by cause with privacy suppression. Test marginal statistical dependence using training-only pairwise Spearman with common support, audit x entry warning prevalences. No conditional perturbation.
resources: Independent single-thread fit jobs and subsequent merged export; two-node Slurm/NFS, private unique run, immutable stages, no evaluation outcomes in fitting input. Verify every new forest and shrunk form, full-grid CIF exactness/reload, actual candidate coverage and event support. Do not merge or upgrade.
privacy: Company IDs, predictions, rankings, real model functions/cuts, detailed cases private. Only aggregate releases. Preserve fails and all planned comparisons.
